items.quote: 26:2 And the LORD appeared unto him, and said, Go not down into Egypt; dwell in the land which I shall tell thee of
items.claim: God appeared and commanded the addressee not to go to Egypt but to dwell in a specified land

items.quote: 26:3 Sojourn in this land, and I will be with thee, and will bless thee
items.claim: God promised to be with the addressee and bless them

items.quote: for unto thee, and unto thy seed, I will give all these countries, and I will perform the oath which I sware unto Abraham thy father
items.claim: God promised to give the addressee and their seed countries and to perform the oath sworn to Abraham

items.quote: 26:4 And I will make thy seed to multiply as the stars of heaven, and will give unto thy seed all these countries
items.claim: God will multiply the addressee's seed abundantly and give them countries

items.quote: and in thy seed shall all the nations of the earth be blessed
items.claim: All nations of the earth will be blessed through the addressee's seed

items.quote: 26:5 Because that Abraham obeyed my voice, and kept my charge, my commandments, my statutes, and my laws
items.claim: Abraham obeyed God's voice and kept His laws, statutes, and commandments
items.object: my voice, my charge, my commandments, my statutes, my laws
